value: Local-validation implementation; production activation requires approved authentication and provider freshness inputs. item_id is the immutable PostgreSQL SKU ID serialized as a string. Missing rows and NULL quantities remain unknown; stored timestamp/version are preserved. Positive stock without a configured freshness policy remains unknown. Existing snapshot-bound cursor semantics are retained: continuation is rejected with 400 if the PostgreSQL snapshot changes or the cursor expires, is altered, or is used with a different limit or policy. Freshness evaluation time is frozen across valid pages. No live acceptance is claimed.
